newsitem.title: INDIA: Paribas upgrades India's Bajaj GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Paribas upgrades India's Bajaj GDRs.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets said it was uupgrading its recommendation on global depositary receipts (GDRs) of India's leading two-wheeler maker Bajaj Auto Ltd to "no action" from the earlier "sell."
"We are maintaining our no action recommendation on Bajaj Auto's local shares, and upgrading our recommendation on the GDRs from sell to no action," Paribas analyst Rajeev Das said.
"Since our last report on the company on 13 May, the local stock has stayed completely flat, the GDR has fallen 15 percent, while the index has fallen 19 percent," Das said in a report.

"While a 17 percent premium on the GDR is still quite high, given that the Indian depositary may be up and running soon, we feel that the GDR's recent fall may have been an over-reaction to falling market shares and a reported cut-back in production."
This fall in the GDR price justified an upgrade, it said.
Bajaj Auto GDR was traded at $32.82 on London Stock Exchange on Tuesday, down from its year's high of $42.37.
